name: OmaPaddock
author: leewynne
description: The big races in your Omarchy bar: Formula 1 (F1), Le Mans and the WEC, MotoGP, IndyCar and NASCAR. A countdown to the next session, and a popup with every race weekend's schedule in your time zone, plus results.

barWidget.description: Countdown to the next F1 session, with every race weekend's schedule in your time zone and tabs for the WEC and Le Mans, MotoGP, IndyCar and NASCAR.

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: race: Mexico City GP · FP1 3d. icon: the chequered flag alone, filled with your theme's urgent colour while a session is live.

schema.label: Bar follows
schema.description: Which series the bar counts down to. any: whichever shown series has the next session.

schema.label: Session times
schema.description: Times are always shown in your local time zone. locale follows the system's time format.

schema.label: WEC and Le Mans
schema.description: Show the World Endurance Championship tab, with the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

schema.label: IndyCar
schema.description: Show the IndyCar tab, with the Indianapolis 500.

schema.label: NASCAR
schema.description: Show the NASCAR Cup Series tab, with the Daytona 500.

schema.label: Refresh interval (minutes)
schema.description: How often the F1, IndyCar and NASCAR schedules refresh: every 2 minutes during a session regardless. WEC and MotoGP calendars refresh every 6 hours.
